profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary: I am a full stack developer creating web applications. I am passionate about working with people to create applications that can help improve their lives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built ASP.NET web apps using Xunit for unit testing, SSMS to interact with SQL databases, and Entity Framework for ORM to improve manual processes such as record retention, generating forms, and ticketing system for the entire organization.
• Led development efforts for PayPal Payflow integration. This allowed board members to donate to International Paper easily which increased turnaround time by 10%.
• Maintained our ticket building web app that handles over 48,000 users. This allowed employees to make requests for equipment during Covid.
• Helped set up CI/CD for development, testing, and  production environments using Azure DevOps for our ASP.NET web applications which improved deployment time by 6%

positions.title: Software Engineering intern
positions.description:
• Built .NET Visual Basic console apps to fetch data from Oracle and Microsoft SQL databases that automatically generated reports each week. This improved the accuracy of the reports by 30% and increased reporting speed by 24%.
• Collaborated with data scientists to build Teradata dashboards for tracking 2 million records of flight data for the business.
• Developed, enhanced, and debugged reporting web apps through Visual Studio.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Google igniteCS provides funding and resources for groups of college and university students to make a difference in their local communities through CS mentorship.
• Partnered with and gained sponsorship from local IT companies within Memphis and carefully chose student mentors from the University of Memphis through a selective interview process
• Mentored 30 middle-schoolers from many impoverished and under-served communities in Memphis, TN, and taught them various computer science-related topics
• Captured images and videos of students learning various computer science concepts in various capacities, including programming Raspberry Pis and flying drones.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: My role is helping out the president of the club with any tasks he assign for me. I also help out with errands for the club, and i am also in charge of setting up for upcoming events that we may have in the future.
